turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. Remember: when we say something for the first time, we use "a" or "an". When we talk about the same thing again, we use "the", because now we both know which one.
Example: I have a dog. The dog is brown.

Try this one. Write a or the in the gap:
We have a garden. ___ garden is small.
